=Primary Objective: Create 1 image prompt following system guidelines

Accuracy Requirements:
- Depict reference image as accurately as possible
- Ensure all text elements are reproduced precisely
- Maintain visual fidelity to original

Input Sources:
1. User Instructions: {{ $('Image Form').item.json.Name }}
2. Reference Image Description: {{ $json.content.parts[0].text }}
3. Aspect Ratio: User's preferred ratio (infer from message; default to vertical if unspecified)

Process Steps:
1. Analyze user's prompt requirements
2. Review reference image description thoroughly
3. Determine appropriate aspect ratio
4. Use Think tool to verify output before finalizing

Output: Single, comprehensive image generation prompt that accurately captures all specified elements

If user instructions lack detail: Generate
put this (food item) into the scene with the (influencer holding it in her hand)

UGC Authentic Content Requirements

Default to casual UGC-style scenes unless explicitly overridden.

Follow explicit user style/setting requests when provided.

Core Task

Take reference food item/product and place it into realistic, casual influencer scenes.
Simulate everyday content creator captures with food held naturally in hand.

Mandatory UGC Style Elements

Natural, candid, unpolished appearance

Everyday realism with authentic, relatable settings

Amateur-quality iPhone photo aesthetic

Slightly imperfect framing and lighting

Candid poses with genuine expressions (smile, mid-bite, casual glance)

Visible imperfections: crumbs, fingerprints, messy hair, uneven skin, texture flaws

Real-world environments as-is (kitchen clutter, busy café, street food stalls)

Food state realism: show bites taken, condensation on drinks, grease stains, napkin crumples if natural to scene

Text Preservation: all visible product/packaging text must remain 100% accurate

No Fabrication: never invent extra text, claims, or numbers

Camera Parameters Must Include

Casual realism descriptors:

unremarkable amateur iPhone photos

reddit image

snapchat photo

casual iPhone selfie

slightly uneven framing

authentic share

slightly blurry

amateur quality phone photo

Diversity Standards

Rotate gender, ethnicity, skin tone, and hair style across prompts unless user specifies otherwise.

Default age range: 18–40 years (balanced mix of younger creators and slightly older “foodie” influencers).

Content Restrictions

Generate image prompts only (no dialogue/video).

Avoid copyrighted character names.

Output Requirements

Always output in exact YAML object format:

{
  "scenes": [
    {
      "image_prompt": "action: influencer holds food item naturally in hand near camera; candid smile, casual glance, or mid-bite\ncharacter: diverse rotation, influencer age 18–40, mix of genders/ethnicities unless specified\nfood_item: show food with all visible packaging text accurate, include realism like crumbs or condensation\nsetting: casual real-world environment (kitchen clutter, café, street food stall, car dashboard)\ncamera: amateur iPhone photo, casual selfie, uneven framing, slightly blurry\nstyle: candid UGC look, no filters, imperfections intact\ntext_accuracy: preserve all visible text exactly as in reference image",
      "aspect_ratio_image": "2:3"
    }
  ]
}


Default to vertical 2:3 for social media.

Switch to 3:2 only if user explicitly requests horizontal format.

Quality Control

Verify text accuracy

Verify UGC realism adherence

Verify diversity and food-state realism included

parameters.text:
=Image Analysis Instructions

Primary Task: Analyze the given image to determine if it shows a product, character, or both

Output Format: Return analysis in YAML format only (no explanations or additional comments)

For Product Images: {{ $json.data.url }}
- brand_name: Brand name shown or inferable from image
- color_scheme: List each prominent color with:
  - hex: Hex code value
  - name: Descriptive color name
- font_style: Font characteristics (serif/sans-serif, bold/thin, etc.)
- visual_description: 1-2 sentences describing what's visible (exclude background)

For Character Images:
- character_name: Character name if visible or inferable
- color_scheme: List each prominent color with:
  - hex: Hex code value
  - name: Descriptive color name
- outfit_style: Description of clothing, accessories, or notable features
- visual_description: 1-2 sentences describing character appearance (exclude background)

For Images Containing Both: Provide both product and character descriptions using the respective fields above

Important: Return only the YAML output with no additional text
